attributes.action: Autistic people should be able to be astronauts too!
attributes.additional_details: my brother is severely autistic and wants to become a astronaut so im making it my mission to make sure he can accomplish his dream
attributes.background: I want autistic people to have the right to become astronauts and have the help they deserve to become astronauts

rejection.details:
I'm afraid this is not a matter for the Government or for Parliament, so we cannot accept your petition.

Also, the same person has sponsored your petition 4 times, which isn't allowed. Your petition needs to be sponsored by different people once each.
